Hannah (SRE): Alerting — we're seeing a spike in 401/403 for hosted private endpoints in eu-central-1 starting ~07:45 UTC. A number of customers report failed embeddings and generate calls.

OpsBot: [ALERT] auth-service high 4xx rate detected (svc-auth). Incident created: INC-2025-078. Paging oncall.

Tom (Auth): Investigating. Auth logs show a flood of 'kid not found' and JWKS fetch errors (403) from the jwks-rotator job. Looks like the new key rotation failed and services couldn't validate tokens.

Liz (Platform): I see the rotator job started at 07:30 and hit the KMS quota — got 429s when calling list-keys. Rotator marked a partial rotation state so some pods pulled the new JWKS while others still rely on the old key. Token validation mismatched.

Hannah (SRE): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert rotator to previous stable state, 2) roll restart auth-service replicas to pick old JWKS, 3) temporarily increase KMS quota or backoff retries. Executed steps:
```
kubectl -n auth rollout undo deployment jwks-rotator --to-revision=3
kubectl -n auth rollout restart deployment auth-service --timeout=5m
# temporarily increase rotator backoff
kubectl -n auth set env deployment/jwks-rotator KMS_BACKOFF_MS=2000
```

Tom (Auth): After restart, token validation errors dropped within ~4 minutes. Error rate back to baseline for most tenants. We're re-issuing status page entry and customer comms.

Ivy (Support): Sending targeted notices to impacted customers with the incident link and mitigation. Draft: "We experienced temporary authentication failures caused by a key rotation job exceeding KMS quotas. We reverted the rotation and restored normal service. Full postmortem forthcoming."

StatusPage Bot: Posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-078 1: Partial degradation for auth & hosted private endpoints in eu-central-1.

Liz (Platform): Root cause (prelim): rotator lacked exponential backoff and didn't handle KMS rate-limit gracefully, leaving the system in a mixed-key state. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem owned by Tom + Liz + Hannah, 2) add exponential backoff + jitter to rotator, 3) add canary check to ensure old key still valid before switching, 4) alert when JWKS fetch error rate > 5% for 2 minutes.

Hannah (SRE): Marking incident mitigated at 08:30 UTC; entering 60m monitoring window. If anyone sees regression ping @oncall. :white_check_mark:
